F30: 175-line per_test_requirement_reach/3 engine has no direct unit test. F38: the rewrite dropped the only assertion that a counters-harvested diagnostic marks the envelope degraded via a boundary row (note: 731b686 added a harvest-only degraded_reasons test — verify whether it fully restores this evidence before writing more). F31: five untested defensive branches (nil-source silently drops coverage). Report F27/F28/F30/F38/F31.

## Orchestrator scoping (synthesized 2026-07-25 by /orchestrate-epic from verified code analysis)

## specled_-dn4.7 — Coverage test isolation + missing evidence (F27, F28, F30, F38, F31)

**Advances:** `specled.coverage_capture`, `specled.triangulation`

Matched obligations: `specled.coverage_capture.mfa_lines_index` (`.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md:436-447`) for F28's subject; `specled.coverage_capture.degraded_reasons` (:514-527) + scenario `scenario.degraded_reasons_overlap` (:843-852) for F38; `specled.triangulation.per_test_requirement_reach` (`.spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md:205-218`) + scenario `scenario.per_test_reach_line_intersection` (:319-330) for F30. Mostly test-only work — the `Advances:` entries exist because `test_tags` enforcement is `error` and any new `@tag spec:` must resolve to a real requirement id.

**Primary files, per finding:**

*F27 — FormatterTest.* `test/specled_ex/coverage/formatter_test.exs:2` is `use ExUnit.Case, async: true`, while `defp arm/1` at :27 does `Application.put_env(:specled_ex, :spec_cover_run, seam_opts)` and `setup` at :22-25 does `Application.delete_env/2` — a production-read global (`Formatter.armed/0` at `formatter.ex:134`, `Boundary.resolve_config/0` at `boundary.ex:91`). Sibling modules already declare `async: false` for exactly this reason: `boundary_test.exs:3` ("Shares Application env arming seam with other coverage tests — must not race"), `case_test.exs:3`, `snapshot_test.exs:2`. The exact-stderr-line-count assertion is at :89-90 (`lines = output |> String.trim_trailing("\n") |> String.split("\n")` then `assert length(lines) == 1`).

*F28 — MfaLinesTest.* `test/specled_ex/coverage/mfa_lines_test.exs:3` is `use ExUnit.Case, async: true`, and `defp compile_fixture/2` at :93-129 does `Code.put_compiler_option(:debug_info, true)` at :113 and restores at :119 — a **VM-global** compiler option, racing every other async test that compiles (there are many: `realization/*_test.exs`, `integration/*_test.exs` all call `Kernel.ParallelCompiler.compile_to_path/3`).

*F30 — no direct unit test.* Verified: `per_test_requirement_reach/3` appears in tests **only** at `test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs:21` (a `# covers:` comment) and :31 (a string inside a `@moduletag`). There is no call site in `test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs`. The engine is `lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex:278-421` — `per_test_requirement_reach/3` (:278-295), `requirement_per_test_reach/4` (:297-347), `tests_hitting_mfa/3` (:349-363), `group_records_with_lines/1` (:367-391), `module_source_index/1` (:396-405), `module_source_file/1` (:407-421), `format_test_display/1` (:423-427) — 144 lines, exercised only end-to-end through `CoverageClosure.build_v2/2`. The natural home for direct tests is `test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs` (currently `async: true` at :14, `@moduletag spec:` list at :16+, which does **not** yet list `specled.triangulation.per_test_requirement_reach`).

*F38 — **assessed: already fully restored by 731b686; do not write more.*** Verified in detail. `731b686` ("fix(specled_-pzd): record degradation provenance; stop auditing never-ran tests") added `test/specled_ex/coverage/formatter_test.exs:485-513`, *"harvest-only degrade records [:counters_harvested]"*, which:

- inserts a **boundary row** carrying the diagnostic — `{{HarvestTest, :"test x"}, %{hits: %{Fixture => [line]}, diagnostics: 1, tags: %{}}}` at :493-497;
- supplies strictly-**increasing** suite snapshots (`%{Fixture => [{line, 0}]}` → `%{Fixture => [{line, 1}]}`, :499-502), so `Snapshot.diff/2` contributes **zero** suite-level diagnostics and the boundary row is provably the sole source;
- asserts the stderr notice (`output =~ "counters-externally-harvested"`, :509), `envelope.degraded` (:511), and `envelope.meta[:degraded_reasons] == [:counters_harvested]` (:512).

That is exactly the dropped evidence: a counters-harvested diagnostic arriving **via a boundary row** marks the envelope degraded. The path it exercises is `flush/1`'s `boundary_diagnostics` accumulator (`formatter.ex:297`, sourced from `records_for_inventory/4`'s `boundary_row.diagnostics` at :403) feeding `total_diagnostics` at :304 and `:counters_harvested` at :328. The complementary suite-diff path is separately covered at :611 ("suite-level negative delta diagnoses and marks degraded"). **Recommendation: close F38 as already-satisfied with this citation, and spend the budget on F31 instead.** The one genuine residual is `state.diagnostic_count` (`formatter.ex:157`, read at :304) — initialized to `0` and **never incremented anywhere in the repo**, i.e. dead; that is already dn4.9's item, not new test work.

*F31 — five untested defensive branches.* Verified candidates, all reachable only via a `nil`/miss and all currently silently dropping coverage:

- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/formatter.ex:252` — `compact_hits_to_files/2`'s `nil -> acc` (module absent from `file_map`);
- `formatter.ex:273-279` — `source_file/1`'s `_ -> nil` (unrecognized `:source` shape) and the `_ -> nil` non-loadable clause, plus the `rescue _ -> nil` at :280-281;
- `formatter.ex:375-376` — the two dead `||` fallbacks (`fallback_test_key/1`, `inventory_module_from_key/1`) — note **dn4.2 deletes these**, so do not write tests for them;
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex:349` — `tests_hitting_mfa(_per_test, nil, _mfa_lines), do: []`;
- `coverage_triangulation.ex:400-404` — `module_source_index/1`'s `nil -> acc`;
- `coverage_triangulation.ex:331-332` — the MfaKey-parse-failure clause folding into `uncovered`;
- `lib/specled_ex/coverage/boundary.ex:122-126` — `table_alive?/1`'s `rescue ArgumentError -> false`.

**Allowed touches (globs):**

- `test/specled_ex/coverage/formatter_test.exs`
- `test/specled_ex/coverage/mfa_lines_test.exs`
- `test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs`
- `test/specled_ex/coverage/boundary_test.exs`
- `test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs`
- `.spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md` (only to add a scenario if a new named behavior is asserted)
- `.spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md` (same)
- `CHANGELOG.md`

**Out of Scope (files):** all of `lib/**`. This ticket adds evidence; if a test proves a defensive branch is *wrong*, file it rather than fixing it here (F8/F11/F23 corrections belong to dn4.5). Also `docs/**`, `.spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md`, `.spec/specs/package.spec.md`, `.spec/specs/mix_tasks.spec.md`.

**Out of Scope (intent):**

- **Do not write a new F38 test.** Verify against `formatter_test.exs:485-513` and close it with the citation above.
- Flipping `async: true` → `async: false` on two modules will slow the suite; do not compensate by introducing `Process.sleep/1` or by weakening the exact-count assertions into `=~` where a count is the actual contract (`.claude/rules/testing.md` bans `Process.sleep/1` outright).
- Any new `@tag spec:` must name an existing requirement id — `test_tags.enforcement: error` in `.spec/config.yml` will fail the build on a typo.

**Verification:**

- `mix test test/specled_ex/coverage/ test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs`
- `mix test --seed 0` and a second explicit seed — the point of F27/F28 is order-independence, so a single seed proves nothing
- `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` (test-tag consistency), then `mix spec.check`
- Stubs, all **`execute: true`**: `coverage_capture.spec.md:929-936` (`mfa_lines_index`), :954-958 (`degraded_reasons`); `triangulation.spec.md:359-368` (`per_test_requirement_reach`).

**Overlap risk:**

- `test/specled_ex/coverage/formatter_test.exs` — the epic's most contended test file: **dn4.1** (4 boundary-row literals at :351/:496/:526/:644 — including the F38 test itself), **dn4.2** (the entire `suite_finished` describe block :266-692), **dn4.4** (arming helper `arm/1` at :27), **dn4.5**, **dn4.9**. Merge dn4.7 **after** all of them so the `async: false` flip and new tests land on final content.
- `test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs` — **dn4.5** (F11's new partitions change what the new F30 tests must assert). Sequence after dn4.5 or the F30 tests get written twice.
- `test/specled_ex/coverage/boundary_test.exs` — **dn4.1, dn4.4, dn4.6, dn4.9**.
